messages:
maya: Quick Q  switching to part-time on 2026-06-01. How does PTO accrual change and what's the carryover cap? Also, I have parental leave starting in Nov and I'm worried about the Q4 launch blackout dates. Any exceptions possible?
rebecca: Congrats, maya! Short answers: accrual is prorated from your FTE change date, carryover cap is normally 40 hours for most roles unless an exception is approved. We do have a company-level blackout week for the Nov launch (Nov 15-20)  teams should avoid scheduling PTO that would block critical coverage. For parental leave overlaps we can grant carryover exceptions or an extended approval window. DM me your dates and manager. :smile:
jON: Simple math: new_accrual = old_accrual * FTE. So 120 * 0.6 = 72 hrs/year. We'll apply the new rate starting 2026-06-01, and payroll will prorate accrual for that pay period. Note: if you hit the accrual cap before you switch, unused hours don't automatically carry above cap without an exception request.
rebecca: To request an exception, submit the internal PTO exception form: https://people.redwood.local/pto-exceptions and include manager sign-off. For blackout exceptions we additionally need product + eng approval. If the leave is statutory parental leave, we prioritize it and will work to avoid penalizing you for blackout weeks.
tom: +1 from me  happy to sign. Maya, send me the expected dates and Ill attach approval. :thumbsup:
maya: Awesome, thanks. One more: during parental leave I might have intermittent sick days when I return  do those affect carryover or approvals?
sarah: Sick days are tracked separately from PTO and generally dont count against carryover. Use the 'Time off' flow in People Ops Hub for each instance. Intermittent sick days typically dont need medical documentation; extended sick leave (multi-week) does require certification. Also, regional public holidays will be auto-applied from the holiday calendar.
rebecca: Quick checklist for the exception form (copy these into the form comments):
``
- employee_id
- FTE change effective date (2026-06-01)
- expected parental leave dates (start/end)
- expected carryover hours requested
- manager sign-off (attach approval email)
- note if statutory leave
```
rebecca: If anyone needs help filling the form I can jump on a 15-min slot today at 3pm PT. Maya, want me to book? :calendar:
thread_text: Part-time conversion + parental leave overlapping Nov launch blackout: accrual math, carryover exception steps
